name: font_manager_generate_def_path

provenance.source: Exact .139 uikit font_manager decompilation; the manager hangs off *0x200bd1e8+28 and its registered-path list uses payload size at +24 and head at +28.

notes: Resolves a font family name to a native file path: returns the path of the first registry entry whose name matches, otherwise builds '<base>/<name>.ttf'. This is the resolution the module confirms after retargeting. UI owner thread only, never under the interrupt lock. Affects only font wrappers created afterwards. Device probe pending.
